name: the assistant explains its pick and offers to act
looks: A chat transcript types on: the user's original request sits at the top, then a reply breaks down why this pick fits, with the same result card appearing inline a beat later. A final line asks permission to place the order, with two buttons settling underneath it.
build: Chat bubbles type on per word, 20-35ms a step, then hold; the result card fades/rises in after the reasoning line finishes; the two buttons fade in last on a short stagger, same mechanic as chat-drives-ui.
sound: A soft typewriter patter under the chat text and a light pop on the card and buttons landing.
prompt: Type on a short chat exchange: the original request, then a reply explaining why a specific pick fits, with a small result card landing inline a beat later, and close on a question asking permission to act, with two buttons settling underneath.
